tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check src/main.js server.js build.js src/client/app.js src/client/pages/name-gen.js src/client/pages/editor.js src/client/lib/puma.ts && deno test --allow-read=dist,src/posts,tests --allow-write=tests
tasks.desktop:dev: deno task build && deno desktop --hmr --include src/posts --allow-env=HOME,XDG_DATA_HOME,LOCALAPPDATA,APPDATA,PORT,DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run=zenity,osascript,powershell server.js
tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run --allow-env=PORT --allow-net --allow-read=dist,src/posts --watch=src/,dist/ src/main.js
